verdict.rationale: Stripe docs explicitly confirm refunds (full or partial) can be issued via Dashboard or Refunds API back to the original card, and Terminal integrates with the same payments/refunds system used across API, dashboard, and POS integrations. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of issuing a refund directly from the physical POS/reader device itself, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of partial refund behavior specifically for Terminal transactions.
